disclaimer: This file is for general educational reference only. It is not medical advice, and it cannot be used to diagnose any individual. Symptoms listed are commonly associated with each condition but overlap across many conditions. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for diagnosis and treatment.
source_note: Information reflects general, widely-accepted clinical knowledge as of early 2026. Always verify against current medical guidelines or a licensed provider.

conditions.name: Iron-deficiency anemia
conditions.description: Low red blood cell count due to insufficient iron, common with heavy menstrual bleeding or pregnancy.

conditions.name: Migraine
conditions.description: Recurrent moderate-to-severe headache disorder, often linked to hormonal fluctuations.

conditions.name: Tension headache
conditions.description: The most common type of headache, often related to stress or muscle tension.

conditions.name: Hashimoto's thyroiditis (hypothyroidism)
conditions.description: Autoimmune condition causing underactive thyroid function; more common in women.

conditions.name: Graves' disease (hyperthyroidism)
conditions.description: Autoimmune condition causing overactive thyroid function.

conditions.name: Type 2 diabetes mellitus
conditions.description: Chronic condition affecting how the body processes blood sugar.

conditions.name: Hypertension (high blood pressure)
conditions.description: Persistently elevated blood pressure; often asymptomatic.

conditions.name: Osteoporosis
conditions.description: Loss of bone density increasing fracture risk; more common after menopause.

conditions.name: Osteoarthritis
conditions.description: Degenerative joint disease from cartilage breakdown.

conditions.name: Rheumatoid arthritis
conditions.description: Autoimmune disease causing joint inflammation; about three times more common in women.

conditions.name: Fibromyalgia
conditions.description: Chronic widespread pain disorder, far more common in women.

conditions.name: Major depressive disorder
conditions.description: Mood disorder causing persistent sadness or loss of interest.

conditions.name: Generalized anxiety disorder
conditions.description: Excessive, persistent worry that is difficult to control.

conditions.name: Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS)
conditions.description: Functional bowel disorder, more commonly diagnosed in women.

conditions.name: Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD)
conditions.description: Chronic acid reflux causing irritation of the esophagus.

conditions.name: Urinary tract infection (UTI)
conditions.description: Bacterial infection of the urinary tract; anatomically more common in women.

conditions.name: Asthma
conditions.description: Chronic inflammatory airway disease.

conditions.name: Allergic rhinitis
conditions.description: Allergic inflammation of the nasal passages.

conditions.name: Common cold
conditions.description: Mild viral upper respiratory infection.

conditions.name: Influenza
conditions.description: Viral respiratory infection, more severe than the common cold.

conditions.name: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS)
conditions.description: Hormonal disorder causing irregular ovulation and elevated androgens.

conditions.name: Endometriosis
conditions.description: Condition where uterine-like tissue grows outside the uterus.

conditions.name: Uterine fibroids
conditions.description: Noncancerous growths of the uterus.

conditions.name: Premenstrual syndrome (PMS)
conditions.description: Cluster of symptoms occurring before menstruation.

conditions.name: Premenstrual dysphoric disorder (PMDD)
conditions.description: Severe form of PMS with significant mood disturbance.

conditions.name: Dysmenorrhea (painful periods)
conditions.description: Painful menstrual cramps.

conditions.name: Menorrhagia (heavy menstrual bleeding)
conditions.description: Abnormally heavy or prolonged menstrual bleeding.

conditions.name: Amenorrhea
conditions.description: Absence of menstrual periods.
common_symptoms: Possible headaches or vision changes (if pituitary-related)

conditions.name: Ovarian cysts
conditions.description: Fluid-filled sacs on the ovary; often resolve on their own.

conditions.name: Pelvic inflammatory disease (PID)
conditions.description: Infection of the female reproductive organs, often from untreated STIs.

conditions.name: Vaginal yeast infection (candidiasis)
conditions.description: Fungal overgrowth in the vagina.

conditions.name: Bacterial vaginosis
conditions.description: Imbalance of normal vaginal bacteria.

conditions.name: Trichomoniasis
conditions.description: Sexually transmitted parasitic infection.

conditions.name: Cervical dysplasia
conditions.description: Abnormal cervical cell changes, often HPV-related; usually found via Pap smear.

conditions.name: Cervical cancer
conditions.description: Cancer arising in the cervix, strongly linked to HPV infection.

conditions.name: Ovarian cancer
conditions.description: Cancer of the ovaries, often diagnosed at a later stage due to vague early symptoms.

conditions.name: Endometrial (uterine) cancer
conditions.description: Cancer of the uterine lining, often presenting with abnormal bleeding.

conditions.name: Vulvodynia
conditions.description: Chronic vulvar pain without a clear identifiable cause.

conditions.name: Vaginismus
conditions.description: Involuntary tightening of vaginal muscles, making penetration painful or impossible.

conditions.name: Adenomyosis
conditions.description: Condition where uterine lining tissue grows into the uterine muscle wall.

conditions.name: Menopause
conditions.description: Natural cessation of menstruation, typically around age 45-55.

conditions.name: Perimenopause
conditions.description: Transitional period leading up to menopause.

conditions.name: Vaginal atrophy (atrophic vaginitis)
conditions.description: Thinning of vaginal tissue due to reduced estrogen, common after menopause.

conditions.name: Pelvic organ prolapse
conditions.description: Descent of pelvic organs due to weakened supportive tissue.
common_symptoms: Sensation of pelvic pressure or bulging

conditions.name: Stress urinary incontinence
conditions.description: Involuntary urine leakage during physical exertion.
common_symptoms: Leakage with coughing, sneezing, or laughing
Frequent need to use the bathroom proactively

conditions.name: Interstitial cystitis (painful bladder syndrome)
conditions.description: Chronic bladder condition causing pain and urinary symptoms without infection.
common_symptoms: Pain that worsens as bladder fills

conditions.name: Female infertility
conditions.description: Difficulty conceiving after 12 months of regular unprotected intercourse.

conditions.name: Ectopic pregnancy
conditions.description: Pregnancy implanted outside the uterus, most often in the fallopian tube; a medical emergency.

conditions.name: Miscarriage (spontaneous abortion)
conditions.description: Loss of pregnancy before 20 weeks gestation.

conditions.name: Preeclampsia
conditions.description: Pregnancy complication involving high blood pressure and organ stress.

conditions.name: Gestational diabetes
conditions.description: Diabetes that develops during pregnancy.

conditions.name: Postpartum depression
conditions.description: Depressive disorder occurring after childbirth.

conditions.name: Mastitis
conditions.description: Inflammation or infection of breast tissue, common during breastfeeding.

conditions.name: Fibrocystic breast changes
conditions.description: Common, benign lumpy or tender breast tissue changes.

conditions.name: Breast cancer
conditions.description: Cancer arising in breast tissue.
common_symptoms: Change in breast size or shape

conditions.name: Breast cysts
conditions.description: Fluid-filled sacs in the breast, usually benign.

conditions.name: Galactorrhea
conditions.description: Milky nipple discharge unrelated to breastfeeding.

conditions.name: Systemic lupus erythematosus (lupus)
conditions.description: Autoimmune disease affecting multiple organ systems; about 90% of cases occur in women.

conditions.name: Multiple sclerosis
conditions.description: Autoimmune disease affecting the central nervous system; more common in women.

conditions.name: Sjögren's syndrome
conditions.description: Autoimmune disease causing dry eyes and mouth; predominantly affects women.

conditions.name: Raynaud's phenomenon
conditions.description: Episodic narrowing of blood vessels in fingers/toes, more common in women.
common_symptoms: Fingers/toes turning white or blue with cold/stress

conditions.name: Chronic fatigue syndrome
conditions.description: Condition of persistent, unexplained fatigue lasting more than 6 months.
common_symptoms: Profound fatigue not relieved by rest

conditions.name: Osteopenia
conditions.description: Lower-than-normal bone density, a precursor to osteoporosis.

conditions.name: Varicose veins
conditions.description: Enlarged, twisted veins, more common in women, often in the legs.

conditions.name: Deep vein thrombosis (DVT)
conditions.description: Blood clot in a deep vein, often in the leg; risk increases with pregnancy and hormonal contraception.

conditions.name: Gallstones (cholelithiasis)
conditions.description: Hardened deposits in the gallbladder; more common in women.

conditions.name: Overactive bladder
conditions.description: Condition causing a sudden, frequent urge to urinate.

conditions.name: Anorexia nervosa
conditions.description: Eating disorder characterized by restriction of food intake and fear of weight gain.

conditions.name: Bulimia nervosa
conditions.description: Eating disorder involving cycles of binge eating and compensatory behaviors.

conditions.name: Binge eating disorder
conditions.description: Eating disorder involving recurrent episodes of eating large amounts of food without purging.
common_symptoms: Feelings of guilt or shame after eating

conditions.name: Melasma
conditions.description: Patchy skin pigmentation, often linked to hormonal changes (pregnancy, contraceptives).
common_symptoms: Brown or gray-brown patches on face

conditions.name: Acne vulgaris
conditions.description: Common skin condition involving clogged hair follicles.

conditions.name: Hirsutism
conditions.description: Excess coarse hair growth in a male-pattern distribution, often linked to PCOS.
common_symptoms: Often accompanied by acne or irregular periods

conditions.name: Female pattern hair loss (androgenetic alopecia)
conditions.description: Gradual thinning of hair, typically at the crown.

conditions.name: Vitamin D deficiency
conditions.description: Low levels of vitamin D, common particularly with limited sun exposure.

conditions.name: Vitamin B12 deficiency
conditions.description: Low B12 levels affecting nerve and blood cell function.

conditions.name: Chronic constipation
conditions.description: Infrequent or difficult bowel movements.
common_symptoms: Fewer than 3 bowel movements per week

conditions.name: Hemorrhoids
conditions.description: Swollen veins in the rectal area, common during pregnancy.

conditions.name: Diverticulitis
conditions.description: Inflammation of small pouches in the colon wall.

conditions.name: Celiac disease
conditions.description: Autoimmune reaction to gluten damaging the small intestine.

conditions.name: Lactose intolerance
conditions.description: Inability to fully digest lactose found in dairy products.

conditions.name: Carpal tunnel syndrome
conditions.description: Compression of the median nerve in the wrist, more common in women.

conditions.name: Plantar fasciitis
conditions.description: Inflammation of tissue along the bottom of the foot.
common_symptoms: Heel pain, especially with first steps in the morning

conditions.name: Temporomandibular joint disorder (TMJ)
conditions.description: Dysfunction of the jaw joint, more commonly diagnosed in women.

conditions.name: Insomnia
conditions.description: Difficulty falling or staying asleep.

conditions.name: Restless legs syndrome
conditions.description: Uncomfortable urge to move the legs, often at night.
common_symptoms: Worsening symptoms at rest or night

conditions.name: Panic disorder
conditions.description: Recurrent unexpected panic attacks.

conditions.name: Postpartum anxiety
conditions.description: Excessive anxiety occurring after childbirth.
common_symptoms: Difficulty sleeping even when baby sleeps

conditions.name: Seasonal affective disorder
conditions.description: Depression that occurs at a specific time of year, typically winter.

conditions.name: Chronic pelvic pain syndrome
conditions.description: Persistent pelvic pain lasting six months or more, with or without an identifiable cause.
common_symptoms: Pain with urination or bowel movements

conditions.name: Asherman's syndrome
conditions.description: Scar tissue formation inside the uterus, often after surgery.

conditions.name: Turner syndrome
conditions.description: Genetic condition affecting females, caused by a missing or altered X chromosome.

conditions.name: Premature ovarian insufficiency
conditions.description: Loss of normal ovarian function before age 40.

conditions.name: Hyperprolactinemia
conditions.description: Elevated prolactin hormone levels, often from a pituitary issue.

conditions.name: Cushing's syndrome
conditions.description: Condition caused by prolonged high cortisol levels.

conditions.name: Addison's disease
conditions.description: Adrenal insufficiency causing low cortisol and aldosterone production.

conditions.name: Gout
conditions.description: Form of arthritis caused by uric acid crystal buildup; risk rises in women after menopause.
common_symptoms: Sudden severe joint pain (often big toe)

conditions.name: Psoriasis
conditions.description: Chronic autoimmune skin condition causing rapid skin cell buildup.

conditions.name: Eczema (atopic dermatitis)
conditions.description: Chronic inflammatory skin condition causing itchy, dry patches.

conditions.name: Melanoma (skin cancer)
conditions.description: Serious form of skin cancer arising from pigment-producing cells.
common_symptoms: Diameter larger than a pencil eraser
